title: A submessage without its required `content`

source.note: composed: negative case for §5.2.4 at a submessage path, completing the three required submessage fields with 13-submessage-missing-subformat and 28-submessage-missing-format.

notes: An absent content is not the same as `content: null`, which Annex A allows and 07-content-null records: one is a field the message does not have, the other a field whose value is null.
